focus_areas: Structural integrity of pipe mounting at the base
Realism of metallic reflections and textures
Geometric straightness and parallelism of vertical pipes
Clarity of boundary between pipes and background
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the base of the pipes where they enter the wooden structure. AI often fails to render realistic mechanical mounts (feet/collars). Check if the pipes appear to 'melt' into the wood. Also, evaluate the consistency of the metallic highlights across different pipes; inconsistent lighting direction is a common artifact.
image_description: A close-up view of a pipe organ facade featuring vertical metallic pipes of varying heights arranged in symmetrical towers. The pipes have a dull metallic finish with visible horizontal bands and decorative elements at the base. The lower section shows a wooden console area with dark wood paneling, though the keyboards and pedalboard are not clearly visible in this cropped frame. The background includes wooden wall paneling.
